漆 World Health Organization

EXECUTIVE BOARD 
Agenda item 9 
EB93/Conf.Paper No.5 
Ninety-third Session 
21 January 1994 
Joint and cosponsored United Nations 
programme on HIV/AIDS 
(Draft resolution proposed by Professor Munewer Bertan, 
Professor J.M.S. Caldeira da Silva, Professor I. Chernozemsky, 
Dr V. Devo, Mrs P. Herzog, Dr J. Larivière, Dr J.G.S. Makumbi， 
Professor J. Mbede，Dr E. Nakamura, Dr Ngo Van Hop, 
Dr B.L. Shrestha and Mr J.F. Varder) 
The Executive Board, 
Taking into account resolution WHA46.37 adopted by the Forty-sixth World Health Ass

blocks.title: No. 10
blocks.content:
recommending the establishment of a joint and cosponsored United Nations programme on H I V / A I D S and 
to have their organizations become cosponsors in accordance with the consensus option; 
4. 
R E Q U E S T S the Director-General to report on this resolution to the World Health Assembly in May 
1994; 
5. 
R E Q U E S T S the Director-General to invite the Secretary-General to recommend to the Economic 
and Social Council that it endorse the establishment of this programme at its 1994 session.
